mapper.sql: select record_id, tenant_id, dept_id, member_id, member_no, member_name, source_type, source_id, dedup_key, growth_change, balance, before_level, after_level, remark, create_by, create_time from mem_growth_record
mapper.insert: insert into mem_growth_record ( tenant_id, dept_id, member_id, member_no, member_name, source_type, source_id, dedup_key, growth_change, balance, before_level, after_level, remark, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{tenantId}, #{deptId}, #{memberId}, #{memberNo}, #{memberName}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{dedupKey}, #{growthChange}, #{balance}, #{beforeLevel}, #{afterLevel}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.select: select balance from mem_growth_record where member_id = #{memberId} order by create_time desc, record_id desc limit 1
